noLink.title: Can’t build a menu link yet

branchBody.both: This restaurant and this branch have no URL slug, so there is no public address to point a QR code at. A slug is the short name in your menu link, e.g. /r/coastal-grill/brooklyn.
branchBody.restaurant: This restaurant has no URL slug, so there is no public address to point a QR code at. A slug is the short name in your menu link, e.g. /r/coastal-grill/brooklyn.
branchBody.branch: This branch has no URL slug, so there is no public address to point a QR code at. A slug is the short name in your menu link, e.g. /r/coastal-grill/brooklyn.

noLink.branchHelp: Slugs are created during onboarding. If yours is blank, set a custom domain in Branch settings instead — that also gives this branch a scannable address — or ask support to fill the slug in.

tableBody.both: This restaurant and this branch have no URL slug, so there is no public address for a table code to point at. A slug is the short name in your menu link, e.g. /r/coastal-grill/brooklyn.
tableBody.restaurant: This restaurant has no URL slug, so there is no public address for a table code to point at. A slug is the short name in your menu link, e.g. /r/coastal-grill/brooklyn.
tableBody.branch: This branch has no URL slug, so there is no public address for a table code to point at. A slug is the short name in your menu link, e.g. /r/coastal-grill/brooklyn.

noLink.tableHelp: Set a custom domain in Branch settings, or ask support to fill the slug in. Your tables are safe either way — the codes appear here as soon as the branch has an address.

branch.title: Branch QR code
branch.introWithTables: One code for the whole branch — the counter, the window, a takeaway flyer. Guests scan it to open {branch}’s menu and pick how they want to order. Tables have their own codes.
branch.intro: Print this and place it at the counter or on a flyer. Guests scan it to open {branch}’s menu and order from their phone.
branch.pngHint: PNG is {size}×{size}px — big enough for table tents and posters.

accessDenied.title: No table access
accessDenied.reason: Only the owner or an admin can set up tables at {branch}.

tables.title: Table QR codes
tables.intro: One code per table. Scanning it opens {branch}’s menu with dine-in and that table already chosen — the guest never picks a branch or types a table number.
tables.editingNote: Editing this table. Its QR code is untouched — every tent already on the floor keeps working.
tables.sortHint: Sort order is what puts table 2 before table 10 — table numbers are text, so left to themselves they sort alphabetically. Leave it blank and the digits in the number are used.

empty.title: No tables yet
empty.description: Add your tables and each one gets its own QR code to print and stand on the table.

retired.title: Turned off
retired.description: Their codes stop pinning a table — a guest scanning one lands on the ordinary menu. Past orders still show the table.

tables.footer: PNG is {size}×{size}px. “Print sheet” lays every active table out two-up for cutting.

rotateConfirm.title: Issue a new code for {table}?
rotateConfirm.body: Every printed copy of this table’s QR stops working immediately.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete {table}?
deleteConfirm.body: Its code is destroyed for good — to retire a table but keep past orders readable, turn it off instead.

errors.duplicateNumber: A table with that number already exists at this branch.
errors.hasOrders: This table still has orders or sittings linked to it, so it can’t be deleted. Turn it off instead.
errors.notPermitted: Your account can’t change tables at this branch.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
